The Shed is a type of

. A shed can also be upgraded to a Big Shed at the Carpenter's Shop. To upgrade this building fully it would cost 35,000g. If purchasing the materials, it would cost 49,500g during year 1 or 107,500g during year 2+.
Sheds act like small farmhouses, allowing players a room inside to decorate however they'd like with
. The exterior is 7x3, smaller than its unupgraded 11x9 interior. The interior of the upgraded Big Shed is 17x12. This allows the player to effectively redistribute space on the farm.
The initial interior of the shed is bare. The interior dimensions of the shed are 11x9, which is approximately the same size as the player's starting
. The Big Shed has dimensions of 17x12, providing slightly more than twice the area of the starting shed.
Note that the "optimal layout" images below apply to mouse/keyboard. Equipment in the corners usually cannot be reached when using a controller.
